text:
## Complaint Prevention Tips  
**To Avoid Issues:**
1. **Verify details** before making transfers (account number, sort code)
2. **Keep records** of all communications
3. **Monitor your account** regularly for unauthorized activity
4. **Report issues quickly** — don't wait weeks
5. **Use secure passwords** and enable 2FA
6. **Ask questions** if something seems wrong

The procedure covers verification of transaction details, record-keeping, account monitoring, timely issue reporting, security practices, and customer inquiry protocols.

raw_entities.description: A preventive step requiring customers to verify critical transaction information including account number and sort code before initiating transfers to reduce errors and fraud risk.
context: Verify details before making transfers (account number, sort code)

raw_entities.name: Keep Communication Records
raw_entities.description: A procedural step instructing customers to maintain records of all banking communications to support dispute resolution and complaint investigation if issues arise.

raw_entities.description: A preventive monitoring step requiring customers to regularly review their account activity to detect and report unauthorized transactions promptly.

raw_entities.description: A procedural step emphasizing the importance of reporting banking issues to the bank without delay to enable faster investigation and resolution.

raw_entities.description: A security step instructing customers to use secure passwords and enable two-factor authentication (2FA) to protect their account from unauthorized access.
